title: lichen-link: default-feature test build broken (ungated tests use alloc-gated items)
description: rust/lichen-link/src/sos_origin.rs tests mod — hex_to_bytes (:244) + domain_matches_vector (:259, uses bare Vec) + 3 tracker_* tests + origin_addr_matches_upstream_pinned_vector reference alloc-gated names (Vec via cfg'd use alloc::vec::Vec, OriginSequenceTracker, SOS_ORIGIN_GATE_DEFAULT_CAPACITY) but are not cfg(feature="alloc") gated. cargo test -p lichen-link with default features (no alloc) fails: E0425 'cannot find type Vec', 'cannot find value SOS_ORIGIN_GATE_DEFAULT_CAPACITY', 'cannot find type OriginSequenceTracker'. CI misses it (only all-features/schnorr legs). Fix: gate the alloc-dependent tests with cfg(feature="alloc") and use std::vec::Vec in domain_matches_vector. Refiled — original bead lost in a store merge.
close_reason: Default-feature test build green. (1) The reported E0425 failures in sos_origin.rs tests were already fixed on main by c365454639 (std::vec::Vec + un-gate upstream oracle test; tracker tests were already alloc-gated) - verified 95/95 lib tests pass with default features. (2) cargo test -p lichen-link with default features still failed on shared_vectors::test_l2_payload_vectors: kind 'sos' unrecognized. Root cause: 11e25f73be ('restore SOS-dispatch files to main's version') mistakenly reverted the Rust side of d5119236d3 (L2 dispatch 0x16=SOS) while vectors+Python+C kept it. Fixed by reverting 11e25f73be (commit f9b0965af1): restores L2_DISPATCH_SOS constant, Sos variant + classify arm, SOS fails-closed arms in rpl_stack/receive.rs, and the sos=>0x16 vector-test arm. Verified: lichen-link default + all-features green (95+171), lichen-core green, cross-checked against Python l2_payload.py and C l2_payload.h. 3x codereview (kimi-k3): correctness PASS, security PASS, edge-cases PASS. Pre-existing (untouched, tracked elsewhere): lichen-node three_rpl_stacks test red = beads jors/cpox; clippy -D warnings sites node.rs:139 + transmit.rs:130 commented on bead zoje.
